convert.quickdescript: converts a file to different format based on uploaded file type or specified in the command.

download.quickdescript: download video/audio from social/music platforms (YouTube, Twitter, Instagram, SoundCLoud, Spotify) *Spotify may not result with a correct song if its not found on youtube.*

abquote.quickdescript: Creates an Anthony Bourdain quote image with two custom text fields

ifruit.quickdescript: Overlays your or specified user's pfp and username/nickname onto the GTA iFruit call screen

riodejaneiro.quickdescript: Adds a Rio De Janeiro instagram filter over image/video

translate.quickdescript: translates text from autodetected language to English, or from one specified language to another.
